subject: maths
question:
Simplify the following.

(x - 3y)³ + 27(y³ - xy²)
solution:
**Given:**

(x - 3y)³ + 27(y³ - xy²)

**Formula used:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - 3a²b + 3ab² - b³

**Calculation:**

(x - 3y)³ + 27(y³ - xy²)

⇒ x³ - 3x²(3y) + 3x(3y)² - (3y)³ + 27y³ - 27xy²

⇒ x³ - 9x²y + 27xy² - 27y³ + 27y³ - 27xy²

⇒ x³ - 9x²y

**∴ The simplified expression is x³ - 9x²y.**
